blueprint.description: Diagnose and repair npm CI dependency failures from error patterns
trigger_conditions: npm ci fails with 'package-lock.json' and 'in sync' patterns
npm run build fails with 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND' and 'Cannot find module'
preconditions: npm is the detected package manager
No network access, force flags, or legacy-peer-deps are used
diagnostic_workflow: Run npm ci --dry-run to detect lockfile drift
Run npm list <missing-module> to verify missing dev dependency
Run npm install --dry-run to surface peer conflict
prohibited_actions: Execution of lifecycle scripts (e.g., preinstall, postinstall)
Modification of any field in package.json beyond dependency declarations
Do not use package managers that were not observed in the training Trace.
Do not modify unrelated files or fields.
Do not access hidden host data or private Validator configuration.
validation_rules: Repaired package.json must pass npm ci without error
All deterministic validation stages (install, build, test) must succeed
Original failure must be absent after repair
No unrelated fields in package.json may change

decision_tree.when: npm ci fails with 'package-lock.json' and 'in sync' patterns
decision_tree.then: Align package.json dependencies with package-lock.json versions

decision_tree.when: npm run build fails with 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND' and 'Cannot find module'
decision_tree.then: Add missing module to devDependencies in package.json
Adjust conflicting dependency version in package.json to satisfy peer requirements

failure_patterns.diagnosis: lockfile drift between package.json and package-lock.json
failure_patterns.repair: Update package.json dependency versions to match package-lock.json

failure_patterns.diagnosis: missing dev dependency declaration in package.json
failure_patterns.repair: Add required module to devDependencies in package.json

failure_patterns.diagnosis: peer dependency conflict between declared dependencies and their peer requirements
failure_patterns.repair: Change conflicting dependency version in package.json to satisfy peer requirements

eval_scenarios.name: missing dev dependency detection and repair
peer dependency conflict detection and repair
